name: Faint Glamour
description: Brush a thin film of false light over a foe's eyes so that edges seem to waver and distances are misjudged.

name: Mirage Touch
description: Press a palm that seems to land a hand's width short so that the true blow arrives unread.

name: Glimmer Guard
description: Flicker a pale double of the forearm beside the true one so that a blow is drawn onto the wrong arm.

name: Shimmer Step
description: Shift a half pace to the side while a faint outline stays on the spot where the body stood.

name: Clear Sight
description: Steady the breath and send qi into the eyes to tell a true shape from a false one at close range.

name: Dazzle Flick
description: Snap a spark of qi-light from the fingertips to break a foe's aim for the span of one heartbeat.

name: Lent Visage
description: Lay a glamour of another face over the user's own so that a watcher mistakes who stands before him.

name: Soft Veil
description: Drape a pale veil of false air about the body that scatters the aim of a thrown or loosed shot.

name: Wavering Fist
description: Throw a fist wrapped in a shaking glamour so that the foe cannot tell where it will land.

name: False Heel
description: Plant a glamour of a heel on the ground ahead and push off from the true foot behind it.

name: Pale Echo
description: Loose a small sphere of qi that carries a false trail so that the foe tracks the wrong path.

name: Steady Eye
description: Hold the gaze unmoving and let qi settle in it until a glamour at close range shows its seams.

name: Doubled Hand
description: Cast a second hand beside the true one to turn a grasp or a blow onto the false limb.

name: Near Mirage
description: Cast a mirage of the user's shape an arm's length away so that the foe commits to the wrong body.

name: Far Mirage
description: Throw a mirage of the user's shape to a distant spot and hold it steady so that the foe turns toward it.

name: Lensed Strike
description: Bend the light about a fist so that its size and reach are read wrongly until it lands.

name: Bent Light
description: Curve a sheet of light across the body so that a blow is aimed at an outline a little aside.

name: Phantom Pace
description: Take a long pace while a mirage of the user walks on a short pace behind.

name: Seeming Test
description: Pulse a thin wave of qi over a suspect shape to learn at once whether it is flesh or a false image.

name: Trailing Image
description: Leave a faint copy of the body hanging in the air at the start of each step.

name: Second Outline
description: Hold a second outline just off the body so that a cut slides through the copy and misses the user.

name: Afterglow Jab
description: Jab with a hand that leaves a bright trail so that the foe blocks the trail and meets the hand.

name: Ghost Stride
description: Walk forward with a string of copies that fade one after another so the true path is lost.

name: Lagging Shade
description: Make a shape of the user seem to move a breath behind the true body so the foe leads his strike too late.

name: Sight Tint
description: Stain the colors a foe sees with a faint wash so that a shape reads as friend or as stone.

name: Faded Blow
description: Strike with an arm that seems to fade out of sight at the instant before it lands.

name: Reversal Palm
description: Raise a palm that shows the foe his own motion reversed so that his blow turns aside.

name: Skein Wrap
description: Wind a loose skein of layered images round the body so that no single outline can be struck.

name: Gapped Stride
description: Hide the middle of a stride behind a false blur so the step seems to skip a pace.

name: Hushed Footfall
description: Wrap each footfall in a false quiet so that the sound of the user's approach never reaches the ear.

name: Truth Look
description: Look through a thin glamour with qi in the eyes to see what lies beneath it.

name: Prism Flare
description: Break a sheet of light into bright shards in front of the foe's eyes to spoil his next stroke.

name: Slipped Hand
description: Hide the striking hand behind a false hand so that the foe guards against the wrong limb.

name: Hidden Wrist
description: Blur the wrist and the elbow so that the turn of the arm cannot be read from the shoulder.

name: Veiled Jab
description: Jab from inside a veil of false air so that the foe sees the blow only as it lands.

name: Cover Sleeve
description: Spread a sleeve of false cloth over the guarding arm so that its real position stays hidden.

name: Sleight Step
description: Slide the lead foot while a false foot stays planted so that the foe measures the wrong gap.

name: Motion Reading
description: Read a foe's hand motion through its glamour to find the true line of the coming blow.

name: Light Bend
description: Bend the light about the body a finger's width so that a cut falls where the user seems to stand.

name: Sound Slip
description: Throw the sound of the user's voice to one side so that the foe turns his head the wrong way.

name: Wavering Screen
description: Hold a trembling screen of light before the body that makes every outline behind it swim.

name: Glare Tilt
description: Tilt a flash of reflected glare into the foe's eyes just as he commits to a stroke.

name: Wisp Shot
description: Loose a wisp of qi shaped like a harmless mote that strikes with the weight of a thrown stone.

name: Wavering Step
description: Step through a ripple of false air that makes the body seem to sway from side to side.

name: Candid Hearing
description: Listen with qi in the ears to sort a true sound from a thrown one and find its real source.

name: Mind Sketch
description: Sketch a simple picture in a watcher's mind with qi so that he believes a thing is nearer than it is.

name: Clear Mind
description: Hold the thoughts still and bright so that a picture planted by another cannot take root.

name: Stray Thought
description: Push a stray thought into a foe's mind at the instant of his stroke to spoil his timing.

name: Idle Gaze
description: Draw a foe's eyes to a false point of interest for the length of one breath.

name: Waking Check
description: Test the mind with a quick pulse of qi to learn whether a vivid sight is real or planted.
